args.body:
• Juniper Labware newsletter: covers freight pricing this quarter, linking to their blog article.
• Main article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Subscriber companion piece (opened with team code SUB-7378): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Juniper Labware Freight Newsletter Summary
